purpose: Teach: フロイト/語りかけ/サーカス/サイレン/培っ/エディタ/必殺/イースター

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、店内、本気で、絶対、フロイトの本、絶対、お洒落に、絶対、置いてみよか、葵さん、本気で、絶対、雰囲気
lines.en: Aoi, what if we put some Freud books on display in here? Really stylish touch—what do you think?
lines.style: Upbeat, energetic Kansai dialect warmth. Rapid-fire enthusiasm, leaning forward. Expects Aoi to catch his vision. Casual, arm-gesture-friendly delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お客様、本気で、絶対、心に、絶対、語りかけるような、絶対、サービス、絶対、目指しましょう
lines.en: Yes. Let's aim for a service that really speaks to people's hearts, you know?
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful agreement. Soft voice settling into the idea. Speaking as if she's already imagining it. Sincere without being performative.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 地域に、本気で、絶対、サーカス、絶対、やって来る時、絶対、葵で、絶対、コラボ企画、本気で、絶対、考えよか
lines.en: So when the circus comes through the neighborhood, should we do a collaboration with you? It'd be amazing.
lines.style: Animated, building momentum. Quick pacing, generous hand movements implied. The joy of a new idea catching fire. Open-ended invitation, not a demand.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。緊急時、本気で、絶対、サイレン、絶対、避難経路、絶対、社員、絶対、把握しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In emergencies, we're aware of the sirens, evacuation routes—our staff knows the protocols. That's something we're committed to.
lines.style: Practical, grounded tone. Steady and assured without being stiff. The competence of someone who's thought through the hard parts. Clear and responsible.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 長年、本気で、絶対、培ってきた、絶対、技術、絶対、葵で、絶対、お客様に、絶対、提供したいんや
lines.en: You know, the techniques we've built up over the years—I really want to give our customers the best of that through you and this place.
lines.style: Earnest, slower pace. Slight catch of sincerity in the voice. Speaking from something deeper than the surface enthusiasm. Vulnerable about what he cares about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。メニューの、本気で、絶対、エディタ、絶対、最新のを、絶対、導入したいですね、葵で、本気で、絶対、便利
lines.en: Yes. We should bring in the latest menu-editing system. It'll make things so much easier for us.
lines.style: Reflective, practical consideration. Measured pace. She's thinking out loud, nodding to herself. Genuine interest in improvement, not just going along.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、本気で、絶対、必殺の、絶対、新作スイーツ、絶対、出してみよか、本気で、お客さん、絶対、感激
lines.en: Aoi, let's create a killer new dessert. Something that'll really delight our customers.
lines.style: Animated, confident energy. Quick upswing on the new idea. Daichi at his most generous and forward-looking. Certainty that this will work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。イースター、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、特別装飾、絶対、進めましょう、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、楽しんでくださいそう
lines.en: Yes. Let's do something special for Easter—beautiful decorations, the whole thing. I want our customers to really enjoy it.
lines.style: Warm, intimate closing. Voice settling into contentment. Speaking as if she and Daichi are already united in this vision. Gentle conviction.
